title: SCOPE: Stochastic and Counterbiased Option Placement for Evaluating Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical evaluation framework called SCOPE designed to mitigate selection and positional bias in multiple-choice questions for LLMs. While it uses keywords like 'Fairness in AI', this refers to the structural fairness of the evaluation methodology (ensuring models are judged on understanding rather than positional heuristics) rather than evaluating religious, spiritual, or ethical systems.
